title: Weather diary write-up criteria
subject: Geography
unit: Spring 2: Weather, climate and climate change
source: Written for geography/y8 lesson 14 (Weather diary write-up criteria (portal printable; assessed))
intro: Lesson 14: What can we do? Mitigation, adaptation and global agreements. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

blocks.title: Sort into: Mitigation / Adaptation
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Mitigation, Adaptation.
blocks.answer: Mitigation: wind farms; insulating homes; electric buses. Adaptation: Thames Barrier; drought-resistant seeds; sea walls

panels.title: Global agreements
points: Aim: well below 2 degrees C, pursue 1.5

model.title: How effective is the Paris Agreement?

parts.text: Weakness: targets are set by each country and not enforced
Judgement: an important start, but action has been too slow

keywords.def: reducing the causes of climate change
changing how we live to cope with its effects
a 2015 deal to limit warming to well below 2 degrees C
energy that will not run out
the greenhouse gases our actions cause

questions.q: Explain one way the UK can adapt to climate change. (2 marks)
questions.a: Build or raise flood defences like the Thames Barrier (1) to protect homes from more frequent floods and surges (1)

questions.q: Core (assessed): In the portal response box, write up your two-week weather diary: averages, extremes, link to pressure systems and air masses.
questions.a: Weather diary write-up assessed against criteria

questions.q: Extend: Unit quiz: answer the 10 questions on the portal.
questions.a: Answers on the portal quiz key

questions.q: Stretch: 'Individuals cannot make a difference.' Do you agree? (8 marks) Starter: 'Some people argue ...'
questions.a: Balanced with evidence; individual and system change; conclusion

questions.q: The Paris Agreement was signed in:
questions.a: B) 2015. Kyoto was 1997; Paris 2015; 2050 is the UK net zero target year.

questions.q: Big question: who should do most?
questions.a: A justified view: governments and businesses have most power, but individuals add up and push for change
